tooltip.barotrauma.oxygen_tank: Right-click to refill your air supply
tooltip.barotrauma.welding_tool: Hold right-click to weld hull plates
message.barotrauma.hull_sonar: The sonar is the ship's brain - it can't be removed
campaign.barotrauma.title: Campaign sea chart
campaign.barotrauma.prompt: Press %s to open map | Select missions and leave %s
campaign.barotrauma.choose: Left-click an adjacent location and tick route missions. Departing without missions is allowed. Scroll the right panel for details.
campaign.barotrauma.boundary: M1 boundary: shared commissions and all-player boarding only. Mission sea instances, objectives and payout are not implemented. The old terminal is a separate system.
campaign.barotrauma.invalid: Invalid or stale route/mission selection. Reopen the map.
campaign.barotrauma.pending: The previous dive request is still pending.
campaign.barotrauma.adjacent_only: Only locations connected to the current one can be selected.
campaign.barotrauma.not_ready: A player has not respawned; all-player boarding is unavailable.
campaign.barotrauma.no_interior: Not enough safe interior positions. Check the ship is loaded, dry and level. Round state was not changed.
campaign.barotrauma.boarded: All players boarded. Mission sea instances are not implemented; no objectives or payouts were generated.
campaign.barotrauma.description.city: A busy settlement with ample supplies.
campaign.barotrauma.description.none: Uninhabited; a potential site for an outpost.
campaign.barotrauma.services.outpost: Original services: trade / repairs / commissions (M1 facilities not integrated)
campaign.barotrauma.faction.coalition: Europa Coalition reputation: %s (original initial value; static in M1)
campaign.barotrauma.mission.salvage.name: Salvage: lost freighter recorder
campaign.barotrauma.mission.salvage.desc: Recover the sealed recorder from a wreck on this route and deliver it for investigation. No time limit. Objective generation awaits mission seas.
campaign.barotrauma.mission.recon.name: Recon: ice fissure survey
campaign.barotrauma.mission.recon.descri: Inspect the fissure and finish a survey scan to chart a safe passage for later crews. No time limit. Scan objectives await mission seas.
campaign.barotrauma.mission.delivery.des: Bring sealed routine supplies safely to the destination. Ordinary delivery has no timer. Cargo generation awaits mission seas.
